steps.en: Install the controller, its CRDs and the extensions into your cluster with one manifest
steps.zh: 用一份清单把控制器、CRD 和扩展装进集群

steps.en: Describe the sandbox once as a template and ask for a pool of pre-started ones
steps.zh: 把沙箱写成一份模板，再要一个预先启动好的池子

steps.en: Keeps the warm pool topped up with started pods, each with a stable name and the template's network policy
steps.zh: 持续补满预热池，每个 pod 有稳定名字并带上模板的网络策略

steps.en: From your agent, claim a sandbox from the pool and run the code the model wrote
steps.zh: 在 agent 代码里从池中领一个沙箱，运行模型写的代码

steps.en: Hands the claim an already-running pod and routes your commands and files to it
steps.zh: 把已在运行的 pod 交给这次申领，并把命令和文件转发进去

value.en: Each agent task gets its own pre-warmed, disposable pod as an ordinary Kubernetes object, with no per-session StatefulSet, Service and volume wiring
value.zh: 每个 agent 任务领到一台预热好、用完即弃的 pod，不再按会话手拼 StatefulSet、Service 和卷

sources: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/agent-sandbox/blob/main/README.md — Installation, Standard Install (kubectl apply -f https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/agent-sandbox/releases/latest/download/sandbox-with-extensions.yaml); Extensions (SandboxTemplate, SandboxClaim, SandboxWarmPool)

https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/agent-sandbox/blob/main/clients/python/agentic-sandbox-client/README.md — Setup: Create a Sandbox Warmpool (kubectl apply -f python-sandbox-warmpool.yaml); Tunnel Mode (client.create_sandbox(warmpool="python-sandbox-warmpool", namespace="default"); sandbox.commands.run("echo 'Hello from Local!'"))
https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/agent-sandbox/blob/main/docs/security/threat_model.md — Managed NetworkPolicy mode for SandboxTemplate; controller in agent-sandbox-system
